speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you have multiple skin lesions; to understand your condition, please describe their appearance, location, and how long they have been present.

speaker: Patient
text: 2-year-old female. The patient's mother reports noticing multiple painless, nonpruritic papules on the child's abdomen. The child attends daycare where another child was reported to have similar lesions recently. Patient's brother had chickenpox one month ago. Immunizations are up-to-date.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for the details. Are these new lesions appearing elsewhere on the body, or just on the abdomen? Also, have you noticed any fever, lethargy, or changes in the child's behavior?

REQUEST TEST: CBC with differential, BMP, and inflammatory markers (ESR/CRP).
REQUEST IMAGES: Clinical photos of the papules.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The normal lab results are reassuring. To better understand the nature of these lesions, could you describe their specific color, size, and whether they appear blanchable (turn white) when pressed? Additionally, do you have the clinical photos I requested to examine their morphology?

DIAGNOSIS READY: Molluscum Contagiosum
